label: First Vatican Council, Dei Filius Ch. 4…… supports A move that affirms that God can be known…
note: Dei Filius ch. 4 separates natural reason from divine faith as principles of knowledge and says God was known by the gentiles through the things made. Knowledge had by those outside the faith, by a principle other than faith, is knowledge that answers to a standard they share. Gap: the council does not say 'shared with outsiders', and the gentiles' knowledge is reported via the Apostle, so it is the council's reading of Rom 1.
